director_mandate_binding.question: On credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript GET-only anchors, is a value-only-rotation (D1V: STALE AND NOT structural_change AND NOT transport_change) population spanning >= 2 independent anchors constructible AT ALL such that the anchor-clustered 97.5% lower bound of the incumbent value-blind guard's false-accept differential (M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V) is non-degenerate and M-N-D1V-ANCHORS >= 2 -- either by admitting a materially different anchor population whose transport validators (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary, final_url) are provably independent of the rotating value, or by a principled instrument change that reclassifies transport-validator motion caused solely by the rotating value itself, with that reclassification justified structurally rather than assumed? The DESIGN must produce a pre-freeze constructibility certificate for the >=2-anchor D1V frame (the exact anchors, the per-anchor transport-change cause, and the arithmetic showing the estimator is powered), and if no such population is constructible on this substrate it must FAIL LOUDLY and return the decisive positive-control-backed bounded reason that parks the four-anchor Part II route -- so that freshness effort can then move to a broader-population guard false-accept/calibration measurement or another sub-mechanism, rather than freeze another structurally degenerate single-anchor read.

estimator_power_arithmetic.theorem: On any D1V trial, B-VALUE-AWARE ABSTAINS (CH-PRECOND-BINDING fires, live != recorded byte-exact) => value-aware FA = 0; incumbent B-INCUMBENT-SIGNAL-ONLY REUSEs iff no other channel fires, and D1V definition guarantees no structural/transport/postcond fire => incumbent REUSE on every D1V trial => per-anchor FA on the D1V subset = 1.0 exactly. Pooled diff = weighted mean of per-anchor FA over clustered bootstrap; LOW < UB97 (non-degenerate) iff two resampled pools differ iff some anchor has per-anchor FA != 1.0 iff CH-POSTCOND-SEM fires on at least one D1V pair of some anchor (postcond change => that anchor's D1V trials with postcond fire become ABSTAIN, FA<1).
